    Build IV formula for use with prepare_data_general

    build_iv_formula.Rd

    Constructs a two-block formula of the form outcome ~ 0 + treatment | treatment ~ instruments + controls for use with prepare_data_general() and instrument_validity_report(). Instrument and control variable names are stored as formula attributes for reliable downstream parsing by .parse_iv_formula().

    build_iv_formula(
  outcome,
  treatment = "budgetdummy",
  instruments = NULL,
  controls = NULL,
  intercept = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    outcome

    Character. Outcome variable name.

    treatment

    Character. Treatment variable name. Default "budgetdummy".

    instruments

    Character vector. Instrument variable names. Default NULL.

    controls

    Character vector. Control variable names to include in the instrument equation only (not the outcome equation). Default NULL.

    intercept

    Logical. Include intercept in outcome equation. Default FALSE (recommended for SCM — weights absorb the level).

    Value

    A formula with attributes treatment, instruments, and controls.
